---
title: "Using CSS and SCSS"
---

## What I Learned

CSS controls the visual appearance of a website, including its colors, fonts, spacing, and borders. SCSS provides additional features, such as variables and reusable styling rules.

For this website, I used a separate CSS file to keep the colors and formatting consistent across the different pages.

## Example

::: highlight-box
This information box is styled by the `styles.css` file. The background color, border, spacing, and rounded corners come from a custom CSS rule.
:::

## CSS Used

``` css
.highlight-box {
  background-color: #f8eeee;
  border-left: 5px solid #7a263a;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 1rem;
}
```

Using a separate CSS file makes it easier to change the appearance of the entire website without editing every page.
